title: Saving and loading scores
description:
Store a dictionary of scores in a text file, one `name,score` per line, and read it back:

```python
def save_scores(path, scores): ...   # writes the scores sorted by name; replaces the file
def load_scores(path): ...           # dict name -> int score; skips blank lines and lines that are not "name,number"; {} if the file is missing
def add_score(path, name, score): ...  # appends one line to the file (creating it if needed)
```

Names may contain spaces; spaces around the name and the number are ignored. A line like `Ada,abc` or `just text` is skipped. Write files as UTF-8.
hints: Strip each line and split it on the comma; a valid line has exactly two parts, a non-empty name and a whole number.
